The '''New Year Honours 1984''' were appointments by most of the [[Commonwealth realm]]s of Queen [[Elizabeth II]] to [[Orders and decorations of the Commonwealth realms|various orders and honours]] to reward and highlight good works by citizens of those countries, and honorary ones to citizens of other countries. They were announced on 31 December 1983 to celebrate the year passed and mark the beginning of 1984 in the United Kingdom,<ref>United Kingdom list: {{London Gazette |issue=49583 |date=30 December 1983 |pages=1–32  |supp=y |nolink=yes}}</ref> New Zealand and the Cook Islands,<ref>New Zealand and Cook Islands list: {{London Gazette |issue=49584 |date=30 December 1983 |pages=33–38  |supp=y |nolink=yes}}</ref> Fiji,<ref>Fiji list: {{London Gazette |issue=49585 |date=30 December 1983 |pages=39–40  |supp=y |nolink=yes}}</ref> the Bahamas,<ref>Bahamas list:{{London Gazette |issue=49586 |date=30 December 1983 |pages=41–42  |supp=y |nolink=yes}}</ref> Papua New Guinea,<ref>Papua New Guinea list: {{London Gazette |issue=49587 |date=30 December 1983 |pages=43–44  |supp=y |nolink=yes}}</ref> the Solomon Islands,<ref>Solomon Islands list: {{London Gazette |issue=49588 |date=30 December 1983 |pages=45–46  |supp=y |nolink=yes}}</ref> Saint Lucia,<ref>Saint Lucia list: {{London Gazette |issue=49589 |date=30 December 1983 |pages=47–48  |supp=y |nolink=yes}}</ref> Saint Vincent and the Grenadines,<ref>St. Vincent and the Grenadines list: {{London Gazette |issue=49590 |date=30 December 1983 |pages=49–50  |supp=y |nolink=yes}}</ref> and Antigua and Barbuda.<ref>Antigua & Barbuda list: {{London Gazette |issue=49591 |date=30 December 1983 |pages=51–52  |supp=y |nolink=yes}}</ref>

The recipients of honours are displayed here as they were styled before their new honour, and arranged by honour, with classes (Knight, Knight Grand Cross, ''etc.'') and then divisions (Military, Civil, ''etc.'') as appropriate.

extract:
The New Year Honours 1984 were appointments by most of the Commonwealth realms of Queen Elizabeth II to various orders and honours to reward and highlight good works by citizens of those countries, and honorary ones to citizens of other countries. They were announced on 31 December 1983 to celebrate the year passed and mark the beginning of 1984 in the United Kingdom, New Zealand and the Cook Islands, Fiji, the Bahamas, Papua New Guinea, the Solomon Islands, Saint Lucia, Saint Vincent and the Grenadines, and Antigua and Barbuda.
The recipients of honours are displayed here as they were styled before their new honour, and arranged by honour, with classes (Knight, Knight Grand Cross, etc.) and then divisions (Military, Civil, etc.) as appropriate.
